audience: Shopify merchants who sell subscriptions with Seal Subscriptions

useCases.title: See which subscriptions will be charged soon
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriptions with a billing attempt between two dates, for example tomorrow or this week, and reads one subscription in full.

useCases.title: Find a customer's subscriptions and failed charges
useCases.text: The AI searches subscriptions by customer email or name and filters by status. It can include billing attempts to show next billing dates and errors.

useCases.title: Skip, bring back or move a billing attempt
useCases.text: The AI skips an upcoming billing attempt, brings a skipped one back, or moves an attempt to another date and time.

useCases.title: Pause, resume, cancel or reactivate a subscription
useCases.text: The AI pauses or resumes a subscription, cancels it now, or reactivates a cancelled one.

useCases.title: Add, change or remove items of a subscription
useCases.text: The AI adds products to a subscription, changes variant, quantity or price of items, or removes items. This changes what the customer pays next.

useCases.title: Email a customer to update the payment method
useCases.text: The AI reads a subscription with failed charges and sends its customer an email with a link to update the payment method.
